definitions.explanation: Without leaving any area unchecked or untouched. Describes searching, looking, or covering an area completely.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}をくまなく{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I searched every corner of the room.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}が{山|やま}をくまなく{捜索|そうさく}している。
examples.english: The police are searching the mountain thoroughly.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり}が{部屋|へや}のすみずみまでくまなく{届|とど}いていた。
examples.english: The sunlight reached every corner of the room.

notes:
「{隈|くま}なく」と{書|か}く。{隈|くま}は「{隅|すみ}」「{暗|くら}いところ」の{意味|いみ}で、「{隈|くま}がない」→「{暗|くら}いところがない」→「すみずみまで」。

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- くまなく{探|さが}す: to search every corner
- くまなく{調|しら}べる: to examine thoroughly
- くまなく{見|み}る: to look all over
- くまなく{捜索|そうさく}する: to search exhaustively

USAGE: Often used with verbs of searching, inspecting, or covering an area. A somewhat literary word, more common in writing and formal speech than casual conversation.
